title: aiBytes gist index
description: content/gists/index.json - every gist, keyed by its source (AIB-145y). The daily run reads it to answer 'does this source already have a gist?' before writing one, and the build reads it for the sitemap. The app never loads it: an item carries its gist's slug. Present once the first gist is written; validate.py checks that it lists exactly the gist files on disk.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change.

generated_at.description: The last run that added a gist.

gists.description: Sorted by slug, so a new gist is a one-line diff. Slugs and source keys are each unique.

source_key.description: The gist's source_url normalised: no scheme, lower-case host without www., no fragment, no tracking parameters, no trailing slash. Stored, so a later change to the rules never changes what an old key meant. See docs/specs/AIB-145y-gist-contract.md.
